notes.title: Quick Update!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! We fixed a small bug - one of the character sprites was displaying incorrectly and looked a bit creepy. All sorted now!

This game's been out since 2019, but we still see people playing it from time to time. When we spot issues like this, we just can't leave them hanging there 😅

Thanks to everyone still enjoying the game!

notes.title: "Alice's World" Steam Page released, the girl hears "your" voice from in front of the screen
notes.content:
https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/33017256/bcb8ac1e2aa0c4c98220fb152a0303ecce06e954.png
Alice's World is a story-driven 2D adventure puzzle game.
The girl opens her eyes in a desolate world, and hears "your" voice from in front of the screen.
You can direct her actions, help her solve mysteries, evade dangers, and find a way to leave this place. Of course, you could also choose not to do so, or even worse, deliberately guide her to death... Just kidding, you surely wouldn't do that, right?
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2439560/Alices_World/
https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/33017256/b49d52caa40ed999c4231937661499124b6de4ac.jpg
【Game Features】
There is no role-playing! You are yourself, sitting in front of the screen, guiding the in-game character.
Explore the stories hidden behind the desolate world, unravel the truth layer by layer.
Exquisite Japanese-style art and full voice acting bring an immersive experience.
https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/33017256/9e79f45938240209d61449759220516509a38062.jpghttps://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/33017256/4d1759dee13a21b06e099af803e9f7edc449b451.gifhttps://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/33017256/ecf8e07845fac84ee2d416a0815515e55ad313e2.jpg
【Story Rich】
https://store.steampowered.com/app/986280/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/766280/

notes.title: "Beyond the Curtains" - Cozy Game Condensing the Stories of Townsfolk
notes.content:
A Serene Story through the Window
https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/33017256/04c81e510aae8a0e3cdf77dfaa950ffdbe94c1b9.gif
Forget the hustle and bustle of everyday life and immerse yourself in a tranquil story unfolding beyond the window. Leisurely observe the landscapes and passing people through the window, capturing moments of soothing tranquility.


Poetry of Objects
https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/33017256/20d0e62fce455718faeab30038d7f09cfa8d3d77.gif
Feeling the owner's profound emotions story through the evolving objects in the room.


Enjoy at Your Own Pace
https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/33017256/09dcd9d86538d019a27d52b415639ff54a10e4d2.gif
Liberate yourself from stress and pressure, taking control of the game's progression at your own pace. With no fear of missing anything, you can savor a delightful healing time.

Add to Wishlist
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2648940
